intro: Written German has a second layer of connecting adverbs above the everyday trotzdem / deshalb / außerdem, and formal texts are made of it. Concession and limitation: allerdings (however — limiting what was just said), gleichwohl (nonetheless), freilich (admittedly), immerhin (at least, still). Contrast: hingegen (by contrast), indes / indessen (meanwhile, however — often both at once). Consequence: folglich, somit, mithin (hence — mithin is the most formal), demnach (accordingly, according to that). Addition: überdies, zudem, ferner, darüber hinaus. Weighing: einerseits … andererseits. They all take position 1 with the verb second, or sit in the middle field after the verb — Die Methode ist allerdings teuer — and, unlike the conjunctions, they connect independent sentences, which is why they are the joints of an argument. Learn them and every argument you read becomes easier to follow.
tips[0].title: Concession: allerdings, gleichwohl, freilich, immerhin
tips[0].text: allerdings limits (however, mind you) · gleichwohl = dennoch, formal · freilich concedes (admittedly, to be sure) · immerhin salvages (at least, still). Die Methode ist präzise; allerdings ist sie teuer. Die Daten sind lückenhaft; gleichwohl zeigt sich ein Trend.
tips[0].check.why: allerdings limits what was just said (however, mind you); immerhin would salvage something positive, and folglich draws a consequence.
tips[1].title: Contrast: hingegen, indes(sen), andererseits
tips[1].text: hingegen = dagegen, formal, usually after the subject: Der Süden hingegen schrumpft. indes / indessen = meanwhile-and-however: Die Kritik verstummte nicht; indes wuchs die Zustimmung. einerseits … andererseits weighs two sides.
tips[1].check.why: hingegen usually sits right after the subject, with no comma; in position 1 it would need the verb straight after it.
tips[2].title: Consequence: folglich, somit, mithin, demnach
tips[2].text: folglich (consequently), somit (thus, therefore), mithin (hence — the most formal), demnach (according to that, accordingly — drawing on a source). Die Annahme ist widerlegt; mithin muss das Modell geändert werden. Laut Studie sinkt der Verbrauch; demnach wirken die Maßnahmen.
tips[2].trap: every one of these takes the verb second: 'Folglich er fiel durch' is impossible. Adverb, verb, subject.
tips[2].check.why: A conjunctional adverb takes position 1, so the verb comes straight after it: adverb, verb, subject.
tips[3].title: Register ladder
tips[3].text: trotzdem → dennoch → gleichwohl · deshalb → folglich → mithin · außerdem → zudem → überdies · dagegen → hingegen → indes. Speech on the left, academic prose on the right.
tips[3].check.why: außerdem → zudem → überdies: überdies sits at the academic end of the ladder.
remember[0]: allerdings (limits), gleichwohl (nonetheless), immerhin (at least), hingegen (contrast), folglich/somit/mithin (hence), demnach (accordingly), überdies (moreover).
remember[1]: Position 1 + verb second, or after the verb.

mistakes[2].why: No comma around a mid-field adverb.
hook: Words like allerdings, hingegen and mithin are the joints of a written argument; spot them and any dense article opens up.
